title: Lekalo Storage Migration Plan
description: Closed independent contract for the immutable deterministic storage migration plan (issue #69). Core derives the plan from the semantic diff of two same-project storage-projection attachments under one engine profile: every step carries its ordinal, its deterministic always-quoted SQL statement, its closed data risk (none, backfill_required, destructive - the storage-projection DataRisk spelling), its declared dependencies, and its explain hook point. A plan containing destructive steps is gated: its status stays blocked, with the exact planId required, until a caller names the digest - the same custody pattern as update --apply and generate --clean --confirm. Core proposes and never executes; apply is adapter-owned under the declared capabilities, and the plan document never carries credentials, hosts, URLs, users, timestamps, or provider output.

baseDigest.description: The canonical digest of the base storage-projection attachment.

candidateDigest.description: The canonical digest of the candidate storage-projection attachment.

diffDigest.description: The digest binding this plan to the exact semantic diff it was derived from.

planId.description: The canonical digest of this plan itself: the exact name a caller must state to confirm a gated plan.

introspectionDigest.description: Optional digest of the checked-mode introspection evidence the plan was conditioned on; a drifted observed schema makes a bound plan stale evidence, never a silent apply.

gated.description: True when at least one step is destructive.

status.description: The plan custody status: ready when nothing destructive exists, blocked while a gated plan awaits its exact planId, confirmed once the caller named it.

risk.description: The closed data risk of one step, spelled exactly as the storage-projection DataRisk.

id.description: The 1-based ordinal of this step in the dependency order.

kind.description: The closed step-kind vocabulary of v1.

statement.description: The deterministic SQL text of this step; identifiers are always quoted.

requires.description: The step ids this step depends on, in ascending order.

explain.description: The declared explain hook point; absent means none.
